title: Active learning finds an opposing-cosolvent electrolyte for aqueous zinc-ion batteries
summary: An extended active-learning framework clustered co-solvent candidates by molecular properties, selected co-solvents and optimized pairwise formulations for tri-solvent aqueous zinc-ion electrolytes with minimal experiments. It found a nonintuitive composition combining co-solvents with opposing properties, which disrupts the hydrogen-bonded network and reconstructs the solvation structure. Zn||NH4V4O10 full cells retained 90.2% capacity after 1,000 cycles. The abstract reports one formulation.
ai_technology: Active-learning framework clustering co-solvents and optimizing tri-solvent formulations

evidence.tested: Zn||NH4V4O10 full-cell cycling with the discovered formulation.
